The '''Totem Pole''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|750}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{tprice|furniture}}, and it can also be purchased for {{Price|1000}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Luau]].

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
